title: Weird Al's Stand Against AI Ads

scenes.text: Weird Al turned down big money for an AI advertisement!
He believes supporting AI ads conflicts with his values as an artist.
This highlights a growing discontent among artists regarding AI's role in creativity.
Artists want their work respected, a sentiment growing stronger in the industry.
scenes.label: SUPPORT CREATORS

scenes.text: Follow for the future, one byte at a time.
